title: AwsConnection
description: How Vulnetix reaches the tenant's AWS estate. One per tenant. sso: IAM Identity Center, which can reach every account the operator's session can; the accounts are AwsAccount documents. iamUser: a long-lived access key, for an estate without Identity Center; the key's own account (from sts:GetCallerIdentity, never from the document) is the connected account. An sso connection starts a device authorization that a person approves in the AWS access portal, so its first apply, and any apply after the session expires, cannot finish unattended. Deleting it disconnects AWS; the stacks deployed in each account stay until removed there.

region.description: The Identity Center region for sso; the region calls are made in for iamUser. An allowlist, because the region becomes part of an endpoint host name.

startUrl.description: The AWS access portal URL. Stored as https://<name>.awsapps.com/start.

accessKeyId.description: An identifier, not a secret: it is in CloudTrail on every call it makes.

secretAccessKey.description: Where the client reads the secret access key. It is proved with sts:GetCallerIdentity, kept in the tenant's vault, and never exported or shown in a plan.

advancedNetworking.description: Report over the private path from the customer's accounts to Vulnetix instead of the internet. Applies to every account; the next stack deploy fills the parameters.
